hook.name: PumpRobinHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 bonding-curve launch hook that charges a 2% WETH fee on every swap (split equally between creator and platform), escalating to 99% during a configurable anti-snipe window; the pool fee is overridden to 0% via lpFeeOverride and the hook takes fees directly via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. LP positions are permanently locked — removal always reverts.
